open_points.subject: Pending confirmation bound inputs
open_points.text: the inputs it is bound to
open_points.question: For an import confirmation, are personal values such as replacement display names copied into the pending confirmation, despite every OwnerSession fact except the uploaded file being classified as `business_confidential`, or does the confirmation hold only a non-personal reference or digest to those inputs?
options: Store only references or digests, keeping the pending confirmation `business_confidential`
Copy the inputs and classify the copied personal fields as `personal_data`
Copy the inputs and classify the entire pending confirmation as `personal_data` when any bound input is personal
open_points.default_guess: Store only references or digests; keep personal values solely in the uploaded import file.

open_points.subject: Confirmation values and identifiers
open_points.text: The confirmation id of an action the owner confirms in it is minted per confirmation, not per session
open_points.question: Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the same identifier as the confirmation id later written to the audit entry and migration closure, or are they distinct values minted at different moments?
options: They are distinct: the pending one-time value is made when shown, and a confirmation id is minted when confirmation succeeds
They are the same value, minted when the step is shown and retained as the confirmation id if used
They are the same value, but it is not minted until the owner submits the confirmation
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as distinct values, with the durable confirmation id minted only for an accepted confirmed action.

open_points.subject: Last-request instant
open_points.text: changed by the owner's requests (State 2 A13, A16; owner, 2026-10-31): the instant of its last request
open_points.question: Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only successful requests, only state-changing requests, or some other set represented by the undefined A13 and A16 references?
options: Every authenticated owner-interface request, including reads and refused requests
Only the request categories later called A13 and A16
open_points.default_guess: Move it on every authenticated owner-interface request.

open_points.subject: Actions with pending confirmation
open_points.text: at most one pending confirmation — its one-time value, the action, its target, the revision or access version and the inputs it is bound to
open_points.question: Which product actions may create this pending confirmation, and why may it contain an access version when State 0 names only project archiving, archived-project erasure, import and audit-entry erasure as confirmed actions?
options: Only the four confirmation actions named in State 0; access version is never present for the current action set
Access-changing actions such as grants, revocations or answering requests also require confirmation
The field is reserved for a future confirmed access action and is absent in this release
open_points.default_guess: Allow pending confirmations only for the four actions explicitly marked as requiring confirmation in State 0; omit an access version when the action has none.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation disposal
open_points.question: Does submitting a stale, malformed, refused or otherwise unsuccessful confirmation count as using it and clear the pending confirmation, or is it cleared only when the confirmed product action is accepted?
options: Clear it on every submission attempt because the value is one-time
Clear it only when the confirmed action is accepted
Clear it for authentication or binding failures but retain it for domain refusals
open_points.default_guess: Clear it on every submission attempt.

open_points.subject: Uploaded import file
open_points.text: at most one uploaded import file, replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted
open_points.question: Is uploading the file a separate owner product action that changes OwnerSession and is later read by the import action, or does the import action itself upload and stage the file while moving through its confirmation step?
options: A separate upload action stores or replaces the session's file; import reads that staged file
The import action uploads and stages the file before its confirmation step
Each confirmation submission carries the file again, with no separate staged-upload action
open_points.default_guess: Use a separate upload action that stages the file in OwnerSession for the later confirmed import.
